items.User: Recreate this anime streaming website's browsing experience as a web app: home page with a hero carousel and rows of shows, browse by genre, search, a series page with seasons and episode list, a watchlist saved in the browser, and a video player page. Use a sample catalog of real anime titles (metadata only) and play official trailers through YouTube embeds instead of full episodes; never link to or stream unlicensed episodes. Use an original name, logo and colours accent, not Crunchyroll's name, logo or trademarks.
